mechanism.form: Override each upstream minecraft:random_spread structure_set at its own namespace path, keeping its structures and placement and adding "frequency": 0.0.
mechanism.why_this_form: A structure_set decides only where WORLDGEN places a structure. Our own copies are pasted with `place template <id>` (tools/place_donor.py:309, tools/place_town.py:380; no tool in tools/ runs `place structure`), which reads the template, not the structure or its set, so the overworld copies we place are untouched. The structure definitions themselves are left alone (copying them would put no-redistribution upstream JSON in our pack).
mechanism.frequency_field: `frequency` is a field of the structure placement, used by packs this server already loads: mega_showdown:archaeological_site 0.45 (mega_showdown-fabric-1.0.2+1.8+1.21.1-release.jar data/mega_showdown/worldgen/structure_set/archaeological_site.json), repurposed_structures:mineshafts_nether 0.00275 (repurposed_structures-7.5.21+1.21.1-fabric.jar). 0.0 is the low end of its range; that the 1.21.1 codec accepts 0.0 and that it then places nothing is what EXP-058 proves.
mechanism.fallback_if_rejected: If the boot rejects frequency 0.0, override the structure's biomes with an empty biome tag instead. Precedent: Terralith ships an empty tag terralith:has_structure/none ({"replace": false, "values": []}, extra/Terralith-DP.zip data/terralith/tags/worldgen/biome/has_structure/none.json) used by terralith:underground/witch_hut. That form copies the structure JSON, so it is the second choice.
mechanism.applies_in_every_dimension: A structure_set is not per dimension: frequency 0.0 stops it everywhere. Nothing is lost in the overworld, which a WorldPainter export writes in full so worldgen places no structure there (docs/world-building/DIMENSIONS_AND_BORDERS.md section 4).

install.why: Its files must win over COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31.zip, which sits in the server's global datapacks/ folder (Global Packs, config/global_packs.toml). A world pack first seen is enabled above every other pack; the spawn suppression relies on exactly that (tools/reapply.py install, EXP-012). The order of two packs inside the global folder is not documented, so the global folder is the unproven choice. The live world gets it through `reapply.py install` with its own world folder, like cobblers_spawns. Worldgen registries load only at a server boot: a /reload does not apply it.
install.when: before anyone enters the Nether or the End. Chunks generated before it is installed keep whatever they placed.
